context: Evaluates correct usage of WallNode schema and wall-specific utility functions from @pascal-app/core. The candidate must create wall nodes via WallNode.parse(), use getWallPlanFootprint to compute 2D footprint corners, use getWallThickness for effective thickness, and reference the exported DEFAULT_WALL_HEIGHT and DEFAULT_WALL_THICKNESS constants.

checklist.name: WallNode creation
checklist.description: Uses WallNode.parse({ start, end }) to create a wall node with 2D coordinate tuples, producing a node with a 'wall_'-prefixed ID and frontSide/backSide defaulting to 'unknown'.

checklist.name: getWallPlanFootprint usage
checklist.description: Calls getWallPlanFootprint with a WallNode to obtain the four 2D corner coordinates of the wall's rectangular plan footprint, using the wall's thickness.

checklist.name: getWallThickness usage
checklist.description: Calls getWallThickness(wall) to retrieve the effective thickness, which falls back to DEFAULT_WALL_THICKNESS when the wall has no explicit thickness set.

checklist.name: DEFAULT constants usage
checklist.description: References DEFAULT_WALL_HEIGHT and/or DEFAULT_WALL_THICKNESS exported constants rather than hardcoding numeric values.
